layout: /RX7/<sequence>/ with the sequence as eight zero-padded decimal digits; summary.bin, thin.bin, full.bin and pulled.flg inside; the sequence is recovered from the folders at boot until F-007 persists it
note: One folder per drive, key-on to key-off; a drive starts at every boot today (BT3), so a key turned on only to pull logs makes a short one

file: The 32-byte header of summary.bin, thin.bin and full.bin
layout: magic "RX7L" @0 · version u8 @4 · tier u8 @5 (0 summary, 1 thin, 2 full) · sequence u32 @6 · start odometer u32 @10 (0.1 mi) · uptime at start u32 @14 (ms) · unix time at start u32 @18 (0 = the clock was unset) · record length u16 @22 · layout CRC-32 u32 @24 · 4 reserved
note: The thin tier's layout CRC is CRC-32 of the string "LC01:4;LC02:4;…LC53:1;" built from log_channels in id order, so the app refuses a record laid out differently; summary and full use CRC-32 of their own layout strings (log_store.h). The header's unix time is not rewritten by a SET_TIME mid-drive; the summary records when and to what the clock was set

layout: the header, then one log_summary_t of 105 bytes (log_store.h): stats.h's peaks, seconds over limits, distance, idle, fuel marks, trips and faults, with start and end odometer, duration, and the time-set record
note: Written every minute and at key-off (the key-off close is not written yet, B7); rewriting it clears its pulled entry

layout: the header, then one 137-byte record per second laid out exactly as log_channels LC01-LC53 in id order; flushed every second
note: Blanks: a message unseen for longer than its timeout (or 1 s) logs 0, TEMP_INVALID (-128) for a temperature; a mean with no samples is 0; the radar is held (sent on change); lambda is the mean of the valid AEM frames

layout: the header, then 15-byte records: uptime ms u32 · id u16 · flags u8 (b0 extended id · b1 id truncated · b2 IMU sample · b4-7 DLC) · 8 data bytes; an IMU sample is a record with b2 set
note: Every frame the ICU sees and the IMU at 50 Hz (D-493); pruned oldest first past three-quarters of the card

layout: no header: per tier the acknowledged length u32 and CRC-32 u32
note: A tier counts as pulled while its acknowledged length equals the file's length, so the open drive drops back to not pulled as it grows; set only on an ACK whose CRC matches (LL08)
